# Upstream Clipper2 (C++) license — Boost Software License 1.0

`clipper2-ts` is a TypeScript port of Angus Johnson's C++ [Clipper2](https://github.com/AngusJohnson/Clipper2)
library. Per `docs/GEOMETRY-OSS-INTEGRATION.md` §14 ("retain the upstream license beside the vendored
source") and the R0 pin's own `licenseNote` (`dev/geometry-tools/pins.json`
`geometryCandidates.clipper2-ts`), both the port's own license (`LICENSE.md`, identical text, copied
verbatim from the npm package) and the upstream reference project's license are retained here.

Fetched live from `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AngusJohnson/Clipper2/main/LICENSE` at vendoring
time (Unit G3, 2026-07-13) and confirmed byte-identical to the npm package's own `LICENSE` file (both
are the unmodified Boost Software License 1.0 text; Boost's convention does not embed a named copyright
holder in the license body itself — attribution is carried in each source file's own header comment,
e.g. `vendor/clipper2-ts/index.js`'s `Author: Angus Johnson … Copyright: Angus Johnson 2010-2025`).
